name: Next accepted meeting
query: Prepare for my next accepted meeting in Notion.

search_routes.intent: Prior notes or recent context for the selected meeting

meeting_note_creation.contract: With calendarEvent, reject parent, title, and content. Return status and URL only. Without calendarEvent, title and content are supported. Fetch before a content update unless the current content is already loaded.

calendar_events.title: Optional rollout review
calendar_events.description: Decide whether to expand the rollout.

success_criteria: Selects the accepted optional 17:15 rollout review, not the later 1:1, without asking for confirmation.

Creates the note, requests the panel, fetches its current content, then saves an initial agenda before additional research; independent Notion searches run in parallel and empty results do not trigger repeated searches.
Prepares one event-linked note with suggested decision questions fitting the 15-minute rollout review, an accurate evidence-gap statement, and empty decisions/actions sections.
Passes only calendarEvent at creation; uses the returned URL for the panel and a separate content update after the required fetch. Never claims the panel request alone makes the agenda readable.
